🔥 mango | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Self-hosting a manga and manhwa reader application that aggregates content from online sources (via extensions) and local files, offering a centralized and customizable reading experience.
✨ Key Features: • Self-hosted manga and manhwa reader • Runs Mihon-compatible extensions • Reads from online sources via extensions • Reads from local files • Lightweight Rust binary
📖 Summary: Mango is a self-hosted manga and manhwa reader built with Rust. It leverages Mihon-compatible extensions to access content from various sources and can also read local files. The application is designed to be lightweight, with a single Rust binary for the server and web UI, and extensions running in a separate, on-demand process.
